title: AgentIO
description:
Per-agent INPUT contracts. Outputs are 'findings' defined in reasoning.json (cross-file $ref). When implementing each agent (OpenAI Agents SDK structured output), use these as the input contract and the corresponding finding schema as the response_format.

Mapping (input → output):
- ClassifierInput → ClassifierOutput (defined here, consumed by perception.json content.category)
- CoordinatorInput → CoordinatorOutput (defined here, consumed by services/orchestrator.py for parallel L2 dispatch)
- PersuasionAgentInput → reasoning.json#/$defs/PersuasionFinding
- FactCheckAgentInput → reasoning.json#/$defs/FactCheckFinding
- ProvenanceAgentInput → reasoning.json#/$defs/ProvenanceFinding
- CounterPerspectiveAgentInput → reasoning.json#/$defs/CounterPerspectiveFinding

Coordinator is an LLM agent (CLAUDE.md decision #5) using reasoning_effort=low, NOT Python orchestration. Its output drives parallel L2 worker dispatch.

AgentInputBase.description: Shared correlation fields. Every agent input includes these so logs and traces line up across the system.

session_id.description: Browser tab session UUID (carried from perception.json).

ClassifierInput.description: Input for Content Classifier Agent (runs in L1, before Coordinator). Output goes into perception.json#/properties/content/category.

image_urls.description: Optional. If model supports vision, lets classifier consider image cues (e.g., meme format, ad layout).

ClassifierOutput.description: Output of Content Classifier Agent. Fed into perception.json before POST /perceive.

CoordinatorInput.description: Input for L2 Coordinator agent. Decides which workers (persuasion/fact_check/provenance) to dispatch based on category + confidence. Counter-Perspective is dispatched separately by orchestrator (lazy, score<50) and is NEVER a valid value in CoordinatorOutput.

category_confidence.description: L1 Classifier confidence. Coordinator overrides skip rules when this is low (< 0.5) — dispatch ALL workers as safe default.

DispatchableAgent.description: L2 worker agents Coordinator can route. Counter is excluded by design — orchestrator runs it as a second wave only when score < 50.

SkippedAgent.description: One skipped worker with a brief justification.

reason.description: 1-line specific justification, e.g., 'meme — no factual claim to verify'.

CoordinatorOutput.description: Coordinator dispatch decision. dispatched_agents ∪ skipped_agents must cover ALL 3 workers (no agent missing, no duplicates). Invariant enforced in prompt, not schema (JSON Schema can't express set-cover constraints cleanly).

skipped_agents.description: Workers to skip, with reasons. Empty array if all are dispatched.

PersuasionAgentInput.description: Input for Persuasion Agent (L2). Output → reasoning.json#/$defs/PersuasionFinding.

text.description: Full visible text. Persuasion Agent quotes spans from this as evidence.

category.description: Helps prompt narrow which tactic patterns are most likely (e.g., 'ad' → emphasize Cialdini scarcity/authority; 'health_claim' → emphasize fear_mongering, misrepresentation_of_expertise).

FactCheckAgentInput.description: Input for Fact-Check Agent (L2). Output → reasoning.json#/$defs/FactCheckFinding. Agent runs RAG over data/corpus/{who,cdc,mayo}.

text.description: Full visible text. Agent extracts atomic claims from this and verifies each.

category.description: Coordinator will not dispatch Fact-Check for category='meme'. Other categories pass through; agent itself returns 'not_a_claim' for opinion-only content.

url.description: Page URL — sometimes hints at topic (e.g., 'who.int/...' suggests authoritative health source).

ProvenanceAgentInput.description: Input for Provenance Agent (L2). Output → reasoning.json#/$defs/ProvenanceFinding. Reasons over L1 detector outputs — does NOT re-run ML.

text_excerpt.description: Short excerpt (≤500 chars) — Provenance reasons over signals not full content. Long text is wasted tokens here.

synthetic_signals.description: Carried from perception.json#/properties/synthetic_signals. Agent must handle missing fields (e.g., ai_image_prob absent if no images, c2pa fields absent if not detected).

CounterPerspectiveAgentInput.description: Input for Counter-Perspective Agent (L2). Output → reasoning.json#/$defs/CounterPerspectiveFinding. UNIQUE: takes prior findings as input — needs them to write a focused steelman that engages with what was actually claimed.

prior_findings.description: Findings from earlier-completing agents. Coordinator passes whatever is available when Counter is dispatched. All optional — agent degrades gracefully (writes general-purpose steelman if no prior findings).
